description:
Sedna yacht-search guidance and available bases.

This tool lists available bases grouped by country and provides operating
guidance for yacht searches.

1. Yacht, fleet, availability and price facts come from Sedna tool results;
   do not invent them.
2. Stay neutral between fleets and present factual differences so the
   customer can decide.
3. Copy `id_tbf1` and `id_boat` exactly from `search_boats` results.
4. If no year is specified, clarify the date or use the current year.
5. Call `Base_list` before `search_boats` and use the returned base name.
name: Base_list
